Streaks count consecutive days. Data is stored on this device only.

📖 How to use

  1. Add the habits you want to build.
  2. Tick each habit on days you complete it.
  3. Watch your streaks grow in the 7-day view.

❓ Frequently asked questions

How do streaks work?

Add a habit, then tick it each day you complete it. The streak counts consecutive days up to today (or yesterday if today is not done yet).

Is my data saved?

Yes — habits and their history are stored in your browser's localStorage.

What does the week view show?

The 7-day strip shows the last 7 days with a dot for each completed day.

Can I delete a habit?

Use the delete button on a habit to remove it and its history.

Is this private?

Yes — everything stays in your browser.
